direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular quantities, time and cost; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the overlapping HOLD badge and RECEIVING label to 11px minimum and give the badge clear space from the machine edge.
Refit the right inspector evidence list so the third item is fully reachable with a visible internal scroll cue at 768px height.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to the Inspect source evidence primary and rail items for keyboard traversal.
Keep Route Health pre-flight and Investigation source evidence as separate headed regions with independent status lines; do not merge their controls.
Enlarge the route select to a 40px target and label it Investigation route, distinct from the Run Sample investigation primary.
Reduce repeated offline explanation to one status sentence in the inspector.
Make each Select this path control a full 36px radio target; selecting it must open the typed consent form with the exact APPROVE phrase.
Align 83h, 35h and 17.5h finish values and costs in fixed tabular columns across the three options.
Move No acceptance recorded into the DecisionBar centre status so the empty state is visible without scanning the inspector.
Fix the clipped route label beside MAT-ALLOY-B · 70 parts and the partially hidden 30-part route so both read fully inside the stage.
Keep 3 proposed · UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL directly above t1-t3 and style proposal cards dashed until approval.
Enlarge Decline proposal to 36px and place it on the same baseline as the proposal end marker.
Make PREVIEW: WILL GO OFFLINE use dashed silver outline on CELL-MILL-2, reserving stoppedRed until Apply second shock is confirmed.
Enlarge the machine select to 40px with a focus ring and keep its label tied to the preview state.
Shorten the inspector to one warning sentence: applying invalidates the accepted Use verified substitute plan.
Stop the bottom option chips overlapping job labels; refit them into one clean row at 11px minimum with CONSTRAINED fully legible.
Increase stopped CELL-MILL-2 cross-hatch contrast while keeping red only on that station, its outline and OFFLINE-STOPPED text.
Keep pre-flight route health separate from the not-run investigation panel, with the Reinvestigate recovery primary only in the DecisionBar.
Give the constrained Split option a disabled style with pattern and reason text, and remove pointer style and keyboard focus from it.
Fix overlapping stage option chips as in the prior state so Wait and Use verified substitute values do not collide with job captions.
State PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED once in the DecisionBar and once in Human Decision, removing duplicate narration elsewhere.
Expand the inspector task region so t3 is not cut at the panel edge; add a clear internal scroll end cue and keep Decline proposal visible.
Visually separate 3 BLOCKED prior tasks from 3 proposed untracked replacements with distinct headings, patterns and counts while showing both together.
Fix clipped route text near JOB-1002 and the MAT-ALLOY-B banner so the approved revised plan route reads end to end.
Sequence Verify ledger, passphrase entry and Export independent checkpoint as numbered locked states, enabling each only after the prior completes.
Enlarge the passphrase field to 40px, keep its 16-160 character rule beside it, and announce errors via aria-live polite.
Refit stage option chips to remove overlap with job due labels while retaining 70, 35h and 48h proof metrics in the inspector.
Replace the disabled-looking Verify ledger button with a Complete · current ledger status chip that is not focusable as an action.
Keep PACKET SEALED summary in the DecisionBar as a single status line and remove any remaining primary action from this terminal step.
Add a final keyboard stop after Back and the sealed status so focus order ends cleanly on the complete step.
